Our Services

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

How far in advance should I book a ride?

We recommend booking at least 48 hours in advance. Recurring rides (like dialysis) can be scheduled indefinitely. Same-day rides are subject to availability.

Do you accept Medicaid?

Yes. We are contracted with major Medicaid brokers. Call us with your member ID and we'll verify coverage right away.

Can family members ride along?

Absolutely. One companion typically rides free. Additional passengers may apply depending on the vehicle.

Are your vehicles wheelchair accessible?

Yes. Our fleet includes ADA-compliant vans with hydraulic lifts and four-point securement systems for manual and power wheelchairs.

What is your service area?

Local metro area. Long-distance transport available on request.
